text.tspan: Exportación de símbolos y redes Eagle originales · archivo CAD adjunto para comprobar detalles
The following pins are not necessary for normal use but can be used for more
J2, J13, J14, J11, J12, and J6 all connect to the driver's control pins, directly to
JP9 and JP10 are shorted in the layout, and can be split to apply current sense
resistors to the A and B channels.
Open JP5 and JP6 before connecting to J2 and J14 for A-side totem drive control
Open JP8 and JP7 before connecting to J6 and J13 for B-side totem drive control
Make sure only one source is driving any net. JP3, JP1, JP2 and JP4 (the pin
connection jumpers) should be considered and fully opened if necessary,
to disconnect all input pins. Then, user wires can be added to re-configure
